method: Eight focused parameter-help unit tests plus Chromium/Playwright checks of visible copy, accessible descriptions, disclosure behavior, mobile layout and actual practice-model regression.

checks.observed: Budget, observation, reserve, reference speed, slope limit, uphill coefficient and downhill coefficient each have a visible field-specific description.
All seven inputs reference nonempty helper elements through aria-describedby. Advanced inputs also reference the explicit non-NASA-operating-limits warning.
Time fields retain minute labels, speed uses m/min, slope uses degrees, coefficients are labeled unitless, and reserve is distinguished from extra margin.
Enter opens advanced assumptions and the separate How these assumptions affect the model disclosure; technical detail is not hover-only.
Click toggles the coefficient detail open/closed. At actual 390 x 844 CSS viewport, document width remains 375 px without horizontal overflow.

Visible 10% uphill with coefficient 4 gives a 1.40 multiplier and 10% downhill with coefficient 2 gives 1.20. Dedicated tests verify both against actual engine edge costs; 10% is correctly described as about 5.71 degrees, not 10 degrees.
Opening and reading help leaves the nominal guided plan unchanged: FEASIBLE with 61.92 min extra margin.
A focused test verifies the additional-observation input explicitly says it adds to the original duration; shortcut buttons still set, rather than accumulate, the extra amount.

limitations: Native HTML details/summary supports pointer and keyboard activation. A real touch-device or emulated-touch-context test was not completed; click and keyboard paths were verified at a mobile viewport.
The examples explain the existing heuristic, not validated astronaut performance or NASA operating standards. No model formula or scientific input was changed.
Earlier 1.1.0 browser, 1.1.1 layer and 1.1.2 destination checks remain historical evidence, not fabricated complete fresh reruns.
No human usability pilot, full screen-reader/accessibility audit, actual hosting deployment or operational safety validation is asserted.
